sloka: ददृशुस्तां त्रयो लोका देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ।शप्तां पतन्तीं निरये त्रिदिवाद्देवतामिव ।। ६.११९.३३ ।।
transliteration: dadṛśustāṁ trayo lokā devagandharvadānavāḥ ।śaptāṁ patantīṁ niraye tridivāddevatāmiva ।। 6.119.33 ।।

translations.english: All the three worlds witnessed noble dark Sita entering the fire, like ghee offered to fire.
